future_check: After changing schedule logic or canonical data, rerun both disjoint 200-per-band censuses and require count-backed support in every band.
rationale: The original generator had zero canonical-profile support. A deterministic 20% anchor schedule keeps generalized shortcut-rebutting examples attached to the empirical task manifold without dominating the distribution.
summary: Every fifth non-overridden sample is an exact linked canonical-morphology anchor.

future_check: An independent monitor should probe larger connected components before upweighting; only extend the bank with shapes that preserve all rival rebuttals and placement feasibility.
rationale: This boundary makes roles, placement, and override observability reliable, but it does not demonstrate every larger connected bitmap the Racket oracle can classify. The Python rule mirror is broader than the generated curriculum, not independent proof of full-shape training coverage.
summary: The teaching bank deliberately uses a finite set of connected shapes with bounding boxes no larger than 3x3.

future_check: Keep both orientation-specific witnesses nonzero in every band whenever the shape banks are edited.
rationale: Generated witnesses include a top-bottom-only object that is erased and a left-right-only object that is preserved, so horizontal-reflection and double-axis-only rivals cannot explain the labels.
summary: Top-bottom symmetry is not the selection rule.

future_check: Retain the two regression seed schedules (3000087/20348 and 3000177/20708) and a 200-lesson census in task-local tests or monitor replay.
rationale: The built-in semantic gate sampled 12 lessons and passed, while the first independent 200-lesson schedule exposed two ambiguous cases. The final repaired schedule identified 200 of 200.
summary: Lesson identifiability must be audited on a long sequential schedule, not inferred from a small random sample.

future_check: Run at least 200 sequential four-example lessons after any placement, profile, or seed-schedule change; stop on the first surviving competitor.
rationale: The first 200-lesson audit found two lessons where the left-half rule fit all demonstrations and disagreed on the query. Placement was repaired at generation time instead of accepting a 99% identifiability rate.
summary: Generalized scenes are horizontally mirrored whenever the left-half position rival would otherwise match the true output.

future_check: Require exact selected-source synchronization plus execution parity of every preserved archival source whenever any Racket authority changes.
rationale: The selected authority already matched the canonical rule byte-for-byte after normalization. Rewriting the 78k-character archival executable source would be unrelated churn, so it was retained only after all three canonical pairs passed for both distinct source texts.
summary: Canonical program_solution and selected target_code are exactly synchronized; archival raw_code remains textually divergent but execution-equivalent.
